$comment: Machine source of truth for prices (built from docs/PRICEBOOK.md). Claude never invents a price: it picks codes, code computes totals. Change = PRICEBOOK.md + this file, approved by Meir; tools/pricebook_test.py diffs the two.

rules.monthly_billing: monthly in advance from the go-live date

annual_prepay.label: 12 months for the price of 10
annual_prepay.text: Paying a year ahead (Upwork Direct Contracts only): setup plus 12 months of the monthly fee for the price of 10 months. This is a prepayment option, not a discount on the monthly fee.

availability.coming_soon_text: Coming soon, after US carrier registration for business texting. Not available to buy yet.

reasons.us_texting_registration: Needs business texting, which starts only after US phone carriers approve our texting registration (A2P 10DLC).

term_plan.status: approved 2026-10-25, NOT published: waits for the Tranzila USD standing-order terminal and the FX rate answer
term_plan.label: Monthly plan, no setup fee
term_plan.formula: plan_b_monthly = monthly + setup * (100 + premium_pct) / 100 / 12, whole dollars
term_plan.early_exit_text: Leaving before month 12 (after the first 30 days): you pay only the part of the setup fee not yet paid, setup x remaining months / 12, in one charge to your card on file. No other fee.
term_plan.eligible: fixed core and add-on items that have a monthly fee; one-time items (ADD-PAGE, ADD-LOGO, ADD-BLOG, ADD-RUSH) stay one-time

refund_rules.status: final (standard-alignment pass 2026-10-12; no attorney review yet)

deposit.condition: client has not completed the access checklist
deposit.text: Changed your mind? Ask within 7 days of paying and we refund your full deposit, as long as you haven't finished the setup checklist.
deposit.label: 7-day refund

retainer.text: Retainers: 75% refund of the first payment if cancelled within 7 days.

rcp_guarantee.not_for: WEB keeps only the 7-day deposit rule: content work starts immediately
rcp_guarantee.label: 30-day satisfaction guarantee
rcp_guarantee.text: 30-day satisfaction guarantee: not happy within 30 days of go-live (the day it starts answering real customers)? We refund the setup fee for your AI assistant and turn it off. On the bundle, we refund only the AI assistant's part of the setup fee, and you keep the website. Monthly fees you already used are not refunded.
rcp_guarantee.legal: If you are not satisfied within 30 days after go-live, tell us in writing (email or the portal) and we will refund the setup fee you paid for the AI Receptionist and switch the AI line off. On the Receptionist + Website bundle, we refund only the AI Receptionist part of the setup fee: the AI Receptionist's stand-alone setup price, less the same percentage discount (if any) you received on the bundle. The website stays yours, and its monthly plan continues unless you cancel it. Monthly fees for the period used are not refunded. This applies to the AI Receptionist and the bundle, not to the website on its own.
